question: If 30 workers earn ₹4140 in 4 days, how much (in ₹) will 55 workers earn in 10 days?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the formula: (M₁ × D₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) / W₂

(30 × 4) / 4140 = (55 × 10) / W₂

120 / 4140 = 550 / W₂

W₂ = (550 × 4140) / 120 = 550 × 34.5

W₂ = 18975

**∴ The correct answer is 18975.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial workers (M₁) = 30

Initial days (D₁) = 4

Initial earnings (W₁) = ₹4140

Final workers (M₂) = 55

Final days (D₂) = 10

**Formula Used:**

The total earning is directly proportional to the number of workers and the number of days: W ∝ M × D

⇒ (M₁ × D₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂) / W₂

 Case 1 30 Workers 4 Days ₹4140 
• 
 Case 2 55 Workers 10 Days ₹18975 Earning ∝ (Workers × Days) 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (30 × 4) / 4140 = (55 × 10) / W₂

⇒ 120 / 4140 = 550 / W₂

⇒ 1 / 34.5 = 550 / W₂

⇒ W₂ = 550 × 34.5

⇒ W₂ = 18975

**∴ The correct answer is 18975.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule Formula

The general formula is (M₁×D₁×H₁)/W₁ = (M₂×D₂×H₂)/W₂, where M = men, D = days, H = hours, and W = work or wages.

Direct Proportion

Wages are directly proportional to the total work done. If number of workers or days increase, the total wage also increases linearly.

Efficiency Aspect

If efficiencies are different, include it in the numerator: (M₁×D₁×E₁)/W₁ = (M₂×D₂×E₂)/W₂.
